**Indikator 6** is a central healthcare quality and safety indicator in the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]], designed to measure the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] (intracranial bleeding) among prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1] [^src4]. Administered by the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP), it serves as a critical safety metric for evaluating anticoagulation treatment, where a high incidence of bleeding may indicate over-anticoagulation [^src4]. 

The indicator relies on data extracted from the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (LPR) and applies to all prevalent patients who were alive and had an atrial fibrillation diagnosis registered in the LPR at least once within the preceding 10 years [^src2] [^src4]. To provide clinical context, the data is analyzed alongside the [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] risk stratification tool and compares the treatment effects of different anticoagulants, such as [[doac|DOAC]] and [[marevan|marevan]] [^src4].

The official quality standard ([[standarden|standarden]]) for Indikator 6 is set at an incidence of ≤ 0.6% [^src1] [^src4] [^src6]. National performance has generally been strong, though regional disparities have occurred. For example, during the 2022–2023 reporting period, the national incidence was 0.5%, meeting the standard, but [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] marginally failed with an incidence of 0.7% [^src2]. By the 2023–2024 period, the national incidence remained at 0.5%, and the standard was met across all regions [^src4] [^src6]. In the subsequent 2024–2025 period, the national incidence for [[danmark|Danmark]] was recorded at 0.6% [^src5].

## Claims
*health*
- Indikator 6: Incidens af intrakraniel blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] (indikator-6)
- Standard for indikator 6 er ≤ 0,6% [^src1] (indikator-6)

*health-statistic*
- I alt blev 0,5% af de prævalente patienter med atrieflimren indlagt med intrakraniel blødning i den aktuelle opgørelsesperiode og standarden (0,6%) er således opfyldt [^src1] (databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark, indikator-6)
- På regionalt niveau adskiller Hovedstaden sig marginalt og med en andel på 0,7% er standarden ikke opfyldt her, i modsætning til de øvrige regioner, der ligger i niveauet 0,4–0,5% [^src1] (region-hovedstaden, indikator-6)

*epidemiology*
- På landsplan udvikler 0,7% af den incidente population blødning og der ses kun beskeden regional variation (0,6–0,8%) [^src1] (indikator-6)

*quality-standard*
- Indikator 6 har standarden ≤ 0,6 % for incidensen af intrakraniel blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren [^src1] (atrieflimren, intrakraniel-bloedning, indikator-6)

*performance-data*
- For Indikator 6 blev den nationale incidens i perioden 01.07.2023–30.06.2024 målt til 0,5 % (95 % CI: 0,5–0,6) [^src1] (indikator-6)

*policy*
- Standarden for Indikator 6 er ≤ 0,6% [^src1] (indikator-6, standarden)

*epidemiological*
- I den aktuelle opgørelsesperiode (01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024) blev 0,5% af de prævalente patienter med atrieflimren indlagt med intrakraniel blødning [^src1] (indikator-6, atrieflimren, intrakraniel-bloedning)

*policy-decision*
- Standarden (0,6%) er opfyldt nationalt og i alle regioner [^src1] (standarden, indikator-6)

*quality-indicator-target*
- Indikator 6 har et udviklingsmål på ≤ 0,6 % [^src1] (indikator-6)

*quality-indicator-result*
- For Indikator 6 var incidensen for hele Danmark 0,6 % (95 % CI: 0,5–0,6) i perioden 01.07.2024–30.06.2025 [^src2] (indikator-6, danmark)
